read.en: Teradyne closed flat on Oct 26 at $309.00, trading between $306.44 and $320.00. It is below the falling 5-day ($321.7), 10-day ($335.2), 30-day ($374.9) and 100-day ($377.9) averages and the rising 200-day ($348.0). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($357.51), and RSI is 33.
read.zh: 泰瑞达 10月26日收平于 $309.00，盘中区间 $306.44–320.00。股价位于下行的 5 日（$321.7）、10 日（$335.2）、30 日（$374.9）和 100 日均线（$377.9）以及上行的 200 日均线（$348.0）下方。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线及零轴下方；抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$357.51），RSI 为 33。

read.en: A push to $320 faded; the close stayed under the $309.4 May 19 low, still resistance. Resistance is $309.4–320 (May 19 low, Oct 26 high), then $321.7–327 (5-day, Oct 20 and September lows). Support is $304.3–306.4 (Oct 23 and 26 lows), then $301–301.9 and $296.8 (spring and July lows). A close below $301 would open $296.8; above $320, $322–327.

r.en: May 19 low, still resistance; Oct 26 high $320
